description: Count triangle words from the pinned Project Euler 42 words fixture, preserving its first-line-only read.

supporting_pinned_source.symbol: fixed input fixture read by solution()

fixture.encoding: ASCII text, one comma-delimited line with a trailing line feed

input.encoding: one ASCII byte value per i64 input element; no header
input.file_read: Only the first line is processed; bytes after the first CR or LF are ignored.
input.null_pointer_with_zero_length: Valid empty file; return zero, matching the scalar ABI runner.

algorithm_contract.triangular_values: int(0.5*n*(n+1)) for n=1..100, equivalently n*(n+1)//2 on this range
algorithm_contract.line_processing: Read the first line; strip CR and LF at its ends; split on comma; strip double quote characters from each token at both ends.
algorithm_contract.word_score: Sum ord(character)-64 for every character in the stripped token; the pinned fixture uses uppercase A-Z, with A=1.
algorithm_contract.counting: Count every token whose score is one of the first 100 triangular values; duplicate tokens count separately.
algorithm_contract.empty_input: Like an empty first line, yielding one empty token of score zero and result zero.

output.result: number of triangular word tokens in the first line
